table.name: CAN Telemetry at Startup
table.description: Exact JK78C producer configuration. Disabled is the default. A validated START command on the derived control CAN ID overrides this byte until reset; STOP forces streaming off until reset. Requires the project CAN telemetry runtime.

table.name: Developer Immobilizer
table.description: Exact JK78C only. Bit 0 enables ECM immobilizer enforcement; clearing it bypasses the Developer Immobilizer transitions and releases the engine inhibit. NATS DTC suppression is independent. Hardware evidence covers a JK08A-derived image on a 23710-JK00D ECU; no other image carries a hardware result.
